label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Mix Up Your Email Content
body: Keep your audience engaged by sending a blend of helpful tips, behind-the-scenes glimpses, and product highlights.
caption:
Sending only sales emails can lead to folks tuning out. Try to balance your messages with different types of content. Share a quick tip related to your niche, give a peek into your creative process, or just share a useful resource.
